sloka: नागानां दशसाहस्रं वाजिनां नियुतं तथा ।रथानां बहुसाहस्रं पत्तीनां च नरोत्तम ।। ७.१९.१२ ॥
transliteration: nāgānāṁ daśasāhasraṁ vājināṁ niyutaṁ tathā ।rathānāṁ bahusāhasraṁ pattīnāṁ ca narottama ।। 7.19.12 ॥

translations.english: Then, that very great army of the king, which was previously destined to be defeated by the heard prophecy and was intent on killing Rākṣasas, marched out.
